nodes.title: Gate 2 S4 built (branch claude/r8-gate2-shadow): play law 4, after a miss the check waits until her act changes. server/forge3/qa/laws.mjs checkWaits: the act that missed, pressed again on the same answer while a try remains, must be off (its control disabled or gone) or refused without playing the miss again or raising a facts count of checks or tries. It runs over every family/mode and served level in three languages, like laws 1-3. The fix is src/play/core/viewkit.ts missWait: the view's react records the state a miss leaves, and the check control is off while that state stands and the law (applied and dropped) would miss again. It is wired into the done/commit/run/sab/next control of 23 views. 48 modes failed; 28 are fixed. 20 stay open in CHECK_WAITS_OPEN (KNOWN law 4 in tests/r8-play-laws), because the act that missed is her answer itself and each needs main's choice: a one-tap pick (strips, nishana round, kyun-lab dhruv, kon/place draw join, rang danger, badlaav gone), a typed number (todo-jodo atoms, nazariya floor and powers, taraazu equality, kon/place measure), or an experiment (aakash, badlaav, bhaap chakra and hawa, chhaano, jaanch daag and neela, rang pehchaan). No first screen changes, so there is no re-cert; a re-cert of an open mode would now fail its cells at laws:L4. Reverse if: real sittings show children pressing a waiting check (the disabled control confuses), or main rules that a repeated experiment or pick is a fresh check.

Gate 2 S1 built: naming runs in shadow for stambh/tally, kon/place and kon/name. The switch is shared/play.ts NAMING_SHADOW (namingShadow), separate from NAMING_OFF, which is unchanged. server/play/shadow.js shadowOf runs the naming rules as built on the unstripped grade at each level end (the grade's own naming, then nameOnRepeat with H1-H7 and the discriminating level), using the session body's own shadow memory (the chance memory afterLevelBody would keep, each sighting with its levelId). It writes wouldName (null, or { mis, rule, by: repeat|act, sightings, levels }) to the /act response's trail and to the trace play.outcome row (its trail and its own key). The rows, evidence and seam tokens, KT events, home fold and seam keep H5's row and an ordinary miss at GAME_WEIGHT; the signed trail never carries wouldName. nextBody never reads the shadow memory, so no level is steered: shadow sightings come only from unsteered levels, and shadow names less often than naming on would. Reverse if: S2's sittings need the steer to collect namings (then steer in shadow and accept that served levels change), or the session token's size matters (the memory holds at most CHANCE_MEMORY = 6 sightings).

Method: S4, laws.mjs law 4 over coverage, 2 seeds, 1 per goal, hinglish (then all three languages in r8-play-laws). Before the fix, 48 family/modes broke law 4. After it, 20 do, all listed in CHECK_WAITS_OPEN; the other 28 break no law. Method: S1, tests/r8-gate2-shadow through the real routes, n = holder sessions of 4 levels (fades 1-3, two door sequences, 1 in 4 from the home). stambh/tally: 30 sessions, 120 tally levels, wouldName on 61 (37 by repeat, 24 by act). kon/place: 72 sessions, 288 levels, 63 (all by repeat). kon/name: 36 sessions, 144 levels, 6 (all by repeat). The seam row, evidence, tokens, KT events and home fold carried no misconceptionId, chanceMis or wouldName. A session with its shadow memory dropped after every level served the same levels, rows, seams, moments, lines and doors.
